gloss: first-time customer; new customer; first visit

definitions.gloss: first-time customer; new customer; first visit to an establishment
definitions.explanation: A customer visiting a shop, restaurant, or establishment for the first time. Often used in traditional Japanese businesses where regular customers are valued.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一見|いちげん}さんお{断|ことわ}りだ。
examples.english: This shop doesn't accept first-time customers.

examples.japanese: {一見|いちげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{歓迎|かんげい}して→歓迎する：26997_kangeisuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: They welcomed me even though I was a first-time customer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一見|いちげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a traditional restaurant that first-timers can't enter without an introduction.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one/first) + {見|げん} (seeing/meeting)

Literally "first meeting/seeing" - refers to the first time a customer visits.

KEY PHRASE:
「{一見|いちげん}さんお{断|ことわ}り」 is a famous expression meaning "first-time customers not accepted." Common at:
- Traditional ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧ (high-end Japanese restaurants)
- Exclusive ⟦お{茶屋|ちゃや}→お茶屋：08935_ochaya⟧ (teahouses in Kyoto)
- Member-only establishments
- High-end ⟦バー→バー：07060_baa⟧ (bars)

CULTURAL NOTE:
This practice exists to:
- Maintain quality of service
- Ensure customers understand etiquette
- Protect privacy of regular customers
- Preserve exclusive atmosphere

Typically, a referral from a regular customer (⟦{常連|じょうれん}→常連：06878_jouren⟧) is needed for first-time entry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一見|いちげん}さん - first-time customer (polite)
- {一見|いちげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ - first-time customer
- {一見|いちげん}お⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ - no first-timers

CONTRASTED WITH:
- ⟦{常連|じょうれん}→常連：06878_jouren⟧ - regular customer
- ⟦お{得意|とくい}→お得意：09990_otokui⟧さん - valued regular customer
- ⟦{馴染|なじ}み→馴染み：07304_najimi⟧ - familiar customer

NOTE ON READING:
Different from {一見|いっけん} (at first glance) which has different kanji reading and meaning.
